# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Barbarian level 7 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human
# Barbarian level-1/level-2/level-3/level-4/level-5/level-6 martial chassis
# baseline to level 7 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not
# contain derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted
# Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and the deterministic
# ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from the level-1..level-6 fixtures,
# adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Barbarian burden surface: no rage-state
# execution engine (activation, round consumption, fatigue, stat
# application), no weapon familiarity, no Rage Power choice-list feature,
# no flanking-resolution engine for Improved Uncanny Dodge (the rogue-level
# comparison that decides whether a flanking rogue can still sneak attack
# the barbarian is not implemented), no damage-reduction-bypass-material
# resolution engine (Damage Reduction 1/- is grounded as a flat magnitude
# only), and no level-8+ progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-barbarian-level7
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:barbarian:7
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:16
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
